lines.zh: 我踩着干河床的碎石走。
lines.en: I walk the gravel of a dry riverbed.
My neck is long and thin, head always moving.
Every two steps I dip my head to look.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾张得很开，抓地稳。
lines.en: My toes splay wide for grip.
I follow the waterline where the ground is soft.
A leaf rustles and I stop.
I cross an open patch at an angle.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，很少发出声音。
lines.en: I step lightly, rarely making a sound.

lines.zh: 前面的沙上有一串脚印。
lines.en: There are tracks in the sand ahead.
I go around them.
I keep to the rock wall, out of the wind.
I watch the sky as I walk.

lines.zh: 一步没踩稳，我赶紧收脚。
lines.en: A foot slips and I pull it back at once.

lines.zh: 我又往水边靠近了一点。
lines.en: I edge a little closer to the water.
I stop at the rim of a shallow pool.
From here I can see both ways.
I crouch with my neck straight up.
Insects on the water. I do not move.
My feathers lie close to my body.
The dry bed is quiet but for wind.
I tilt my head and listen.
This pool is too small.
I blink once, slowly.

lines.zh: 我把长嘴探进浅水里探鱼。
lines.en: I dip my long snout into the shallows for fish.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，停在那儿。
lines.en: I lift one foot and hold it there.
There is a fish moving under the water.
I lower my head a little.
My tail feathers almost touch the ground.
Heavier steps somewhere far off.
I do not look up.

lines.zh: 我的蹼足在河床边停住。
lines.en: My webbed feet stop on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 干河床的鱼，我一只只叼。
lines.en: I pick fish out of the dry riverbed one by one.
You are too big. I back away.

lines.zh: 退到石头后面，我才敢看。
lines.en: Behind the rock, I dare to look.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就露出半个头。
lines.en: You keep still and I show half my head.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，脖子一伸一缩。
lines.en: I tilt my head, neck stretching and drawing.
No net in your hands. Good.

lines.zh: 旱河床上，蹲下的人才不像怪物。
lines.en: On the dry riverbed, only a crouching figure stops looking like a monster.
I try half a step closer.
Then I retreat behind the rock.

lines.zh: 我一下跳开，羽毛全竖起来。
lines.en: I spring away, feathers all standing.
I shrink behind the rock.
My wing knocks against something. It hurts.
One of my legs is trembling.
My breathing is quick as a small bird's.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，水珠溅到石头上。
lines.en: I shake my head; droplets spatter the stones.
I try to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我缩起长脖子，躲到石后。
lines.en: I tuck my long neck and hide behind a stone.
I back toward the water.
Only there can I get away.
Something swims in the water.
I fix on the movement.
I bring my head down to the surface.
The fish you set down is still moving.
One step and it is in reach.
I take it and back off.
I shake it twice before swallowing.
This is bigger than what I catch.
When it is gone I look at your hand.
If there is more, I will wait.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我一跳就开了。
lines.en: You touch me and I spring away.

lines.zh: 我贴着卵石滑开，躲进裂缝。
lines.en: I slide over the pebbles into a crevice.

lines.zh: 翅膀张了一下，又收回去。
lines.en: My wings open once, then fold.
I was only startled.

lines.zh: 你退后，我才从缝里出来。
lines.en: You step back, and I come out.
I pull my neck in and look like a stone.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子探到你手边。
lines.en: My long neck reaches toward your hand.
Do not move suddenly.
I am small. I cannot take a blow.
I slip around to your side.
Another is across the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我们隔着水看了一会儿。
lines.en: We look at each other across the water.
She lowers her head to drink first.
Only then do I go over.

lines.zh: 两条长嘴一起探进水里。
lines.en: Two long snouts dip into the water together.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸一缩，节奏一样。
lines.en: Our necks stretch and draw in the same rhythm.
There is water here. And fish.
Enough for the two of us a while.
The light fails and she is still crouched there.
I did not leave either.
I take it in my beak. Very light.
Not fish. I drop it.
I nudge it with a foot.
It rolls to the water's edge and stops.

lines.zh: 我叼起一条鱼，尾巴还在拍。
lines.en: I pick up a fish, its tail still flapping.

lines.zh: 干河床上，我下水去抓鱼。
lines.en: In dry riverbeds I wade for fish.
I carry it two steps.
Then I set it down.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛上的水抖进河里。
lines.en: I shake the water from my feathers into the river.
Something is still moving there.
A flash under the water.
A twist of my neck and I am looking.
A fish, and not large.
Just one mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 我伏下身子，蹼足踩稳卵石。
lines.en: I crouch, webbed feet steady on the pebbles.
One foot shifts half a step.
It has not yet noticed.
That shadow on the water is mine.
I hold even my breath still.
It swims near to me.
Another inch closer.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我朝那边扎下去。
lines.en: A splash sounds, and I dive toward it.
I fix on that ripple.
It goes left; my head follows.

lines.zh: 我的脖子像一条准备弹的弦。
lines.en: My neck is a drawn string.
My feet shift in the sand.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面追那条鱼的影。
lines.en: I skim the surface chasing the fish's shadow.
I go to the other side and wait.
The surface stirs again.
There it is again.
My head reaches forward.
Half a foot of distance left.
I open my long beak.
The water bursts up.
I catch only water.
My beak stabs into the water.
Got it. A small one.
A duck-like bill with sharp teeth.
I lift my head and shake it down.

lines.zh: 水从我的羽毛上流下来。
lines.en: Water runs off my feathers.
I retreat onto dry ground.
I pin it with one foot.
Then take it again and swallow head first.
My throat bulges once.
In a moment it is gone.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住鱼背，甩了两下。
lines.en: I bite the fish's back and shake it twice.
The water's edge is quiet again.

lines.zh: 我站在干河床的石头上。
lines.en: I stand on a stone in the dry riverbed.
There used to be water here.

lines.zh: 现在只剩下一个个浅坑。
lines.en: Now only shallow hollows remain.
I lift my head and look a long while.
Wind blows sand to my feet.

lines.zh: 干河床上，我从卵石间钻出。
lines.en: On the dry riverbed, I slip out from the pebbles.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的日光也是这样的。
lines.en: The Cretaceous sun was like this too.
I head down the riverbed.

lines.zh: 脚印留在沙上，很快被吹平。
lines.en: My prints stay in the sand, soon blown flat.
Where there are fish, I am there.
First I must find water.
The rest is easy.
I lower my head and sniff.
This direction is right.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的羽毛，我一头扎进水里。
lines.en: Fire catches my feathers and I dive into the water.

lines.zh: 我从石壁上掉下去，摔在沙上。
lines.en: I fall from the rock wall onto the sand.

lines.zh: 水比我以为的深，我拼命往上挣。
lines.en: The water is deeper than I thought; I fight upward.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，沙扑了一身。
lines.en: The blast flips me and sand covers me.
Wet feathers don't stop arrows.

lines.zh: 光一罩，我的腿就不听使唤。
lines.en: Light falls, and my legs stop obeying.

lines.zh: 好几天没鱼，我的腿发软。
lines.en: Days without fish; my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 闪电劈进河床，我的蹼抽搐。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the riverbed and my webbed feet spasm.

lines.zh: 河床底下空了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The riverbed gives way and I fall.
